t: You're looking at 1 to 5 York Gate, a Grade I listed terrace of houses on the edge of Regent's Park. It was designed by John Nash, the architect behind many important parts of London, in the neoclassical and picturesque styles. His work was financed by the Prince Regent and by the property developer James Burton. Nash also worked closely with Burton's son, Decimus Burton. Here, as across this part of the city, you're seeing the Georgian and Regency vision he helped create.
